fixed_statement:
Let $(k,1^d)$ be any hook of size $\ge 1$. Let $SR_n$ be the super-coinvariant algebra from Proposition 4. Let $\mathrm{OSP}(n)$ denote the number of Ordered Set Partitions of $[n]$.

For any hook of size $\ge 1$, the irreducible $GL(1|1)$ module $S^{(k, 1^d)}(\mathbb{C}^{1|1})$ has dimension 2, spanned by a highest-weight vector and its lowering derivation. The total dimension of $SR_n$ is exactly $\mathrm{OSP}(n)$, the number of Ordered Set Partitions of $[n]$.
fixed_proof: It is a canonical combinatorial theorem (e.g., Haglund--Rhoades--Shimozono) that the total dimension of $SR_n$ is exactly $\mathrm{OSP}(n)$, the number of Ordered Set Partitions of $[n]$.
